operations.description: If the sound system pointer global dword_5EB10C is non-null, call its vtable method at offset 12 to refresh it.

Resolve UI binding object ID 39 by calling the vtable factory at offset 28 on the object stored at this[16]; store result in v2.
Resolve UI binding object ID 41 by calling the same vtable factory at offset 28 on this[16]; store result in v3.
If v2 (binding object for ID 39) is non-null, call sub_47C360 on it with parameter 1 to activate it.
If v3 (binding object for ID 41) is non-null, call sub_47C360 on it with parameter 0 to deactivate it.
Invoke code location loc_41C540 with the game state pointer global dword_5EB978.
